result.question: What did Athaliah see before she tore her clothes?

readings.answer: The king standing by the pillar
readings.support: saw the king standing by the pillar

readings.answer: The officers and trumpeters beside the king
readings.support: The officers and trumpeters were beside the king

readings.answer: All the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets
readings.support: all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets

assessments.reason: The text states she “looked out and saw the king standing by the pillar,” matching the key exactly.

The sentence continues, “The officers and trumpeters were beside the king,” describing the same scene just before “Then Athaliah tore her clothes,” so it is reasonable she saw them too, though the explicit ‘saw’ attaches to the king.

It adds, “all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets,” part of the scene immediately before she tore her clothes, so it is a reasonable thing she saw, even if not the specific focus of the ‘saw’ clause.
